format: Action Replay DS save: the 500-byte 'ARDS000000000001' header written by a converter ('Converted Saves' / 'Converted Save' / 'Conversion code by UniqueGeeks.Net'), then 256 KiB raw for the 128 KiB EEPROM (cut 262144 -> 131072; the rest was data (113290 bytes not 0xFF), dropped (--drop-tail))

rom.name: Pokemon Mystery Dungeon - Explorers of Sky (USA).nds
rom.note: a dump of this game code whose sha1 is not in the No-Intro DAT (the area after the used ROM size is blank); the region in the name is a guess
